thread:
Sam - Support: heads up - ACME escalated. Their app is intermittently getting 500s and they found what looks like an SSN inside a debug bundle we returned. request_id=01F7a9b2e4ff, customer timestamp 2025-06-15T14:12:03Z. Need repro steps + sanitized payload to send to eng.
Priya - Eng Oncall: thanks Sam. Can you paste the request_id + the minimal curl you used (with secrets replaced) and the exact API path/version? also confirm whether this was Hosted API or Dedicated.
Sam - Support: path: POST /v1/generate (hosted). request_id=01F7a9b2e4ff. Original prompt contained a full SSN and a full name — i'm not going to paste that raw here. Customer gave permission to collect a scrubbed debug bundle. They attached a zip but flagged as containing PII.
Luis - Privacy: good call not to paste raw. For the scrub we need: replace person names, emails, phone numbers, SSNs with tokens. Prefer tokens like <NAME_1> <SSN_1>. Also redact any JWTs/keys. If Sam uploads a bundle, set ACL to private and add retention 7d.
Maya - Customer success: i'll coordinate with ACME to get a sanitized repro if possible. sam, can you ask them for a minimal curl that reproduces the 500 with placeholders? example: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"input":"<REDACTED_PROMPT>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Sam - Support: asked customer for that, they sent a version where they replaced SSN with Xs but left some context. i'm going to run the debug-bundle collector with the scrub flags and upload.
Priya - Eng Oncall: thanks. When you run the collector, include --include-logs and --request-id. Here's the exact command we prefer (please redact customer token):
```
redwood-cli debug-bundle collect \
  --request-id 01F7a9b2e4ff \
  --include-logs \
  --scrub --replace-names --replace-emails --replace-phones --replace-ssns \
  --output acme-01F7a9b2-scrubbed.zip
```
Make sure debug-bundle prints the scrub summary (lines redacted count).
Sam - Support: running now. uploading to support-private S3, will add access to eng-oncall + privacy for 72h.
debug-bot: debug-bundle uploaded: https://s3.redwood-internal/acme-01F7a9b2-scrubbed.zip (private link) :white_check_mark:
Luis - Privacy: I reviewed the scrub log: 3 names replaced, 1 SSN replaced, 2 email tokens replaced. Please confirm no base64 blobs that might contain raw data. also ensure the curl in the bundle has "<REDACTED>" for auth.
Sam - Support: confirmed: curl had "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>". I also included the original prompt with tokens: "Customer asked: 'Transfer $<AMOUNT> to account <NAME_1> with SSN <SSN_1>.'"
Priya - Eng Oncall: perfect. i'll try to repro locally with the scrubbed bundle. if i hit the 500 I'll paste stack trace and wire-level logs here. expected repro window: p95 latency for this route is ~120ms but customer sees spikes to ~3s before 500.
Maya - Customer success: letting ACME know eng will look. i'll follow up on whether they can craft a minimal prompt that still reproduces the error without any real PII.
Sam - Support: One quick note for eng: the customer reported this started after a recent model swap on 2025-06-14 04:00 UTC. request_id above correlates to that timeframe.
Priya - Eng Oncall: noted. assigning to eng-runtime (fyi @eng-runtime). i'll post progress updates here. first step: reproduce with scrubbed bundle. if reproduced, we'll create a canary patch and test on staging before reaching out to ACME.
Sam - Support: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. tagging privacy and cs for audit trail.
Luis - Privacy: I've attached a short checklist in the bundle metadata: [REDACT] names/emails/phones/ssns/jwts, set s3_acl=private, retention=7d, allowed_viewers=(eng-oncall, privacy, support). keep me in loop if anything else looks off.
Priya - Eng Oncall: received. i'll update thread when I have reproduction steps or need more data.
Maya - Customer success: thanks all, i'll keep ACME updated.
Priya - Eng Oncall: update 1748054880: reproduced locally using the scrubbed prompt; stack trace points to tokenization edge-case in the model as well as a timeout in our request router. creating internal ticket IR-8721. assigning to @relay-team.
